messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a routing policy swap for apac-1 to route traffic to the new edge pool tonight at 02:00 UTC. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m windows. Need an owner for the push and smoke checks. Rollback ready?
jon: I can own the rollout. I'll run the policy activation and the traffic nudges.
lee: I’ll own monitoring and live smoke checks (logs/latency/5xx). Oncall for that window is me + anita.
anita: I'll stand by for rollback and will kick the circuit-breaker if error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. Can we confirm the health endpoint and thresholds?
sam: DNS note: our provider has up to ~60s propagation for weight changes; prefer using the control-plane routing weight API rather than DNS TTL dance. If we must touch DNS, lower TTL to 30s at 00:45 UTC.
maria: good call. Jon — please use the routing API. Also post the runbook link and the exact command you'll run.
jon: runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/edge-routing-swap (read-only)
jon: command I'll use (control-plane):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/v1/routing/shift \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"apac-1","target_pool":"edge-new","pct":10}'
```
ops-scripts: Quick check script to validate canary after each step:
```bash
# verify health across edge nodes
for ip in $(cat /tmp/edge-new-ips); do curl -sS http://$ip/health | jq -r '.status'; done
# latency percentiles from datadog query (shortened): query:avg:trace.http.latency{env:prod,region:apac-1}.rollup(max,60)
```
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: job-id=canary-apac-1856001234, will execute at 02:00:00 UTC. Logs will appear in #eng-platform-deploys.
lee: I'll be watching logs + frontend latency dashboard. Ping me if any >=95th jumps or 5xx spike.
anita: Rollback steps if needed: 1) pause routing job 2) set pct back to previous config (documented in runbook) 3) notify infra pager. I'll trigger.
maria: Can everyone react to this thread with :thumbsup: once they have their hand on their pager and test commands ready? Also, who will do post-rollout sanity after 1h?
jon: I'll do the 1h sanity checks and post a short summary.
sam: I'll be on standby for DNS fallback adjustments.
lee: :thumbsup:
anita: :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — posting a final preflight at 01:45 UTC. If any blockers surface earlier, @here mention me.
